name: Tri-Color Customer
description: A big Lego-like customer spanning 3 lanes with 3 rows of colored cups. Only the front row takes marbles; when all 3 cups in it are full, the row unclips and the next row slides forward.
howToPlay: Tap boxes to send marbles down. Watch the big joined customer at the bottom: fill all three cups in its front row (a full cup waits and blocks its lane until its row-mates are full). The row then snaps off and the next one becomes active. Clear everything to win.
author: Seckin Ege Aydemir

showcaseLevel.name: Tri-Color Customer
showcaseLevel.desc: One big 3-lane customer: fill a whole row to unclip it
